title: SaaS Cohort Retention & Churn Analytics Suite (Phase 1)
problem: Leadership had no granular visibility into monthly cohort renewal rates across customer tiers.
solution: Modeled 3-year historical subscription data in dbt; created dynamic retention matrices and hazard curves.
outcome_metrics: Identified that month-3 drop-offs were driven by onboarding gaps; interventions saved $340k ARR.

title: Executive Revenue & Pipeline Attribution Dashboard (Phase 1)
problem: Marketing and sales teams argued over attribution across multi-touch lead funnels.
solution: Built W-shaped multi-touch attribution model joining HubSpot marketing touchpoints with Salesforce opportunities.
outcome_metrics: Reallocated 25% of underperforming ad spend into high-converting webinars, increasing pipeline ROI by 38%.

title: Supply Chain Inventory Optimization & Reorder Engine (Phase 1)
problem: Factory faced frequent stockouts of critical micro-components causing 5-day assembly delays.
solution: Formulated safety stock and economic order quantity (EOQ) optimization models with seasonal forecasting.
outcome_metrics: Reduced component stockout incidents by 82% while decreasing total held inventory capital by $180,000.

title: A/B Test Evaluation Platform & Statistical Engine (Phase 1)
problem: Product managers frequently declared winning variants prematurely due to p-hacking.
solution: Built automated sequential testing framework with Bonferroni correction and sample size calculators.
outcome_metrics: Eliminated false positive feature rollouts, protecting an estimated $1.2M in annual GMV.

title: Healthcare Operational Flow & Bed Capacity Model (Phase 1)
problem: Hospital ER faced severe bottlenecking and average wait times exceeding 4.2 hours.
solution: Analyzed 120,000 patient admission records to simulate hourly patient arrival distributions and bed turnover.
outcome_metrics: Optimized nurse staffing shifts, reducing average ER wait times by 46 minutes (18% drop).
